title: THE SECOND BELL
meaning:
The Second Bell is a situation, a conversation or a person returning a second time. The first signal passed without an answer; the second is fainter, and it is the same.

The card suggests that what you did not resolve is still ringing.
imageAlt: Two bells far apart. The first hangs perfectly still; the second sways slightly although there is no rope. A very faint repetition of a signal.
